dopant_roles.basis: Electron doping; the defining substitution for T'-cuprates.
Oxygen reduction is required to make the electron-doped phase superconduct.

basis: LaNiO3 (49) rhombohedral R-3c perovskite, mp-19339. La2NiO4 members in the tail are Ruddlesden-Popper.

dopant_roles.basis: LaNiO3-delta reduces readily; oxygen content drives the metal-insulator behaviour.

basis: Ba0.5Sr0.5Co0.8Fe0.2O3 (BSCF, 44) cubic perovskite with large intrinsic oxygen deficiency.

dopant_roles.basis: BSCF is heavily oxygen-deficient; delta is the dominant variable, not an impurity.
B-site alloying at x=0.2, not dilute doping.

basis: WO3 (15) plus oxygen-deficient WO3-x. The measured 49-1100 K range crosses three steps of the WO3 tilt-distortion series, so no single space group describes these samples: gamma P2_1/n at room temperature, beta Pbcn above ~603 K, alpha P4/ncc above ~1013 K.
taxonomy_feedback: reo3_wo3 previously listed only the cubic Pm-3m aristotype. A distortion_series field was added to prototypes_seed_v3 recording the full epsilon-delta-gamma-beta-alpha-cubic sequence with transition temperatures, since every measured WO3 is a distorted variant.

dopant_roles.basis: WO2.90 and WO2.9: oxygen deficiency is the carrier source, drives the Magneli/bronze series, and suppresses or displaces the distortion transitions.
(Bi2O3)x WO3 is a composite/second-phase addition rather than substitution.
Alkali bronze formation in the tunnels.

other_polymorphs.note: The cubic ReO3 aristotype itself, approached only near the melt (~1170 K+) and rarely reported; the taxonomy previously named this as WO3's structure.

basis: Al70Pd20Mn10 (17) icosahedral quasicrystal, the classic i-AlPdMn system. No periodic structure.

dopant_roles.basis: Composition within the icosahedral phase field.

basis: CuCrO2 (16 as Mg-doped) delafossite R-3m, a transparent p-type oxide. Mg on the Cr site is the standard acceptor.

dopant_roles.basis: Acceptor; the defining dopant for CuCrO2.

basis: Cu2-xS (Cu2S, Cu1.97S, Cu1.8S) -- the sulfur analogue of Cu2Se, superionic above ~376 K. Cu deficiency spans chalcocite to digenite and is the carrier knob.
low_evidence_note: MP's Cu2S primary rests on 1 ICSD reference at hull 0.045; the ordered low-temperature chalcocite superstructure is not well represented.

dopant_roles.basis: Cu2-xS: copper deficiency sets the hole concentration. This is the doping variable.
Cu5FeS4 bornite is a deliberate composite second phase.

basis: Sr0.61Ba0.39Nb2O6 (26) is the SBN tetragonal tungsten bronze, not a perovskite. SrNbO3 (6) is a genuine perovskite and Sr2Nb2O7 a layered niobate -- three structures in one host.

dopant_roles.basis: Ba:Sr ratio tunes the relaxor behaviour in SBN.
Sr0.85NbO3 and reduced niobates rely on oxygen deficiency for conduction.

basis: CuAlO2 (33) delafossite R-3m, the archetypal transparent p-type oxide. The Ca/Sr additions are at sub-percent level.

dopant_roles.basis: Excess oxygen generates the p-type carriers in CuAlO2.

basis: CuFeS2 (20) chalcopyrite; Cu5FeS4 (7) is bornite, a different sulfosalt in the same host.

dopant_roles.basis: The standard carrier-tuning substitution in CuFeS2.
Cu/Fe off-stoichiometry tunes the carrier count.

basis: CuInTe2 (33) chalcopyrite I-42d, the I-III-VI2 ordered zincblende superstructure.

dopant_roles.basis: Cu vacancies are the intrinsic acceptor.

basis: NbFeSb (14) half-Heusler, mp-9437 hull 0; Ti/Zr/Hf on the Nb site is the standard p-type route.
low_evidence_note: mp-9437 carries only 1 ICSD reference despite NbFeSb being well characterised; the snapshot is thin here.

dopant_roles.basis: Acceptor; the main p-type dopant for NbFeSb.

basis: SrIrO3 (35) and Sr2IrO4 (21). SrIrO3 is the monoclinic distorted perovskite (a 6H hexagonal polymorph also exists) and Sr2IrO4 is the n=1 Ruddlesden-Popper spin-orbit Mott insulator.

dopant_roles.basis: Sr:Ir ratio selects perovskite versus the RP member.

basis: Mg3Sb2 (31) CaAl2Si2-type Zintl, mp-2646. Excess Mg is required to reach n-type behaviour.

dopant_roles.basis: Mg3.2Sb2 and similar excess-Mg compositions fill cation vacancies; essential for n-type conduction.

basis: Yb14MnSb11 (18) and Yb14MgSb11 -- the 14-1-11 Zintl, the highest-performing p-type high-temperature thermoelectric. Yb11GaSb9 and Yb4Sb3 are separate phases in this host.

dopant_roles.basis: The 14-1-11 transition-metal site; Mg/Al/Zn substitution here tunes the carrier count.
Electron doping on the Yb site.

basis: Elemental Te (33), helical chains P3_121, mp-19 with 20 ICSD references. Te melts at ~723 K, inside many high-temperature runs.

dopant_roles.basis: Te-Se forms a complete solid solution.

basis: BaFeO3-delta (6) perovskite; Ba2Fe2O5 (4) is the ordered oxygen-vacancy brownmillerite of the same chemistry.

dopant_roles.basis: BaFeO3-delta spans perovskite to brownmillerite; the dominant structural variable.

basis: Ge1-xPbxTe alloys, Ge-rich (median Ge/(Ge+Pb)=0.82). Rhombohedral at room temperature, converting to rocksalt near 700 K; Pb content lowers the transition temperature.

solid_solution_axis.note: Pb alloying suppresses the rhombohedral distortion, so the transition temperature is composition-dependent across this host.

dopant_roles.basis: Isovalent alloying; also shifts the structural transition.
Ge vacancies set the intrinsic hole concentration.

basis: CuO (9) monoclinic tenorite and Cu2O cuprite in the same host; separated by copper oxidation state.
SnO2 (20) cassiterite, rutile-type mp-856 with 44 ICSD references. Sb on the Sn site is the standard donor.

dopant_roles.basis: Oxygen vacancies are the intrinsic donor.

basis: PbTe1-xSx alloys, all rocksalt. PbTe-PbS has a wide miscibility gap, so many nominal compositions are two-phase.

solid_solution_axis.note: PbTe-PbS phase-separates over much of this range; the nanostructuring that results is the point of these papers.

dopant_roles.basis: Isovalent; drives phase separation and phonon scattering rather than doping.

basis: UO2 (43) fluorite, mp-1597 with 28 ICSD references. Gd2O3 additions are the burnable-poison solid solution.

dopant_roles.basis: Aliovalent solid solution; creates oxygen vacancies.

basis: Ag2Se (46) orthorhombic below ~406 K, converting to the bcc superionic phase above it -- inside the measured window.
low_evidence_note: mp-754954 carries 0 ICSD references; the beta-Ag2Se structure is poorly represented in the snapshot.

dopant_roles.basis: Ag2.001Se and Ag1.9Se1.1: silver excess/deficiency sets the carrier count.

basis: SiC (43) polytypes. The C/(C+Si) spread reflects off-stoichiometry and free carbon, not a genuine solid-solution axis.
axis_check: The detected C/(C+Si) axis is spurious: SiC is a line compound. The spread comes from off-stoichiometric compositions (Si1.1C, SiC0.7) and free carbon, not from substitution.

dopant_roles.basis: Donor, the standard n-type dopant for SiC.
Si:C off-stoichiometry leaves free Si or C rather than substituting.

basis: Bi2Ca2Co1.7O8 (23) -- the [Bi2Ca2O4][CoO2]x misfit layered cobaltite, the Ca analogue of the Bi-Sr phase.

other_polymorphs.note: Incommensurate; the rocksalt and CoO2 subsystems must be mapped separately.

dopant_roles.basis: Hole doping, standard in Bi-based misfits.

basis: Cu26V2Sn6S32 (18) is colusite, a distinct sulfosalt with a cubic P-43n framework; Cu2SnS3 (11) is the diamond-like ternary and Cu4Sn7S16 a third phase. Colusite has no entry in the taxonomy.

dopant_roles.basis: Part of the colusite framework stoichiometry, not a dopant.
Cu content tunes the hole count in colusite.

taxonomy_feedback: colusite proposed here and accepted into prototypes_seed_v3.

basis: BaCoO3-delta hexagonal (2H BaNiO3-type) perovskite dominates the doped members, but Ba2Co9O14 (11) is a distinct layered cobalt oxide, not a perovskite at all.
note_structure: BaCoO3 adopts the 2H hexagonal face-sharing variant rather than the cubic corner-sharing net; Ba2Co9O14 needs its own assignment.

dopant_roles.basis: BaCoO3-delta oxygen content sets the Co valence.

basis: Ba8ZnxGe46-x type-I clathrate; Zn substitutes into the Ge framework and sets the electron count. No seed hypothesis was offered for this host.

dopant_roles.basis: Framework electron count, not dilute doping.

basis: B4C (16) and B13C2 (5) are the icosahedral boron carbide series. ErB22C2N and Y1.08B22.3C2N are boron-cluster framework phases of a different structure type.
note_structure: The RE-B22C2N members belong to the YB22C2N framework family, not to B4C; a v4 prototype would be justified if more appear.

dopant_roles.basis: B4C-B13C2 is a homogeneity range; the C fraction is the carrier knob, not an impurity.

basis: GdBaCo2O5+delta (23) is the A-site ordered double perovskite; the Gd and Ba layers alternate and the oxygen vacancies order in the Gd plane.

dopant_roles.basis: The 5+delta oxygen content is the doping variable and drives the metal-insulator behaviour.

basis: SrFeO3-delta (13) cubic perovskite; Sr3Fe2O7 (4) is the n=2 Ruddlesden-Popper member. Oxygen content spans perovskite to brownmillerite.

dopant_roles.basis: SrFeO3-delta: delta spans the perovskite-brownmillerite range and dominates the transport.

basis: Ba8AlxSi46-x type-I clathrate. Al substitutes the Si framework; the Al:Si ratio sets the Zintl electron count.
CuGaTe2 (34) chalcopyrite, mp-3839 hull 0 with 11 ICSD references. Cu2Ga4Te7, CuGa3Te5 and Cu3Ga5Te9 are ordered-vacancy compounds derived from the same tetrahedral net.
note_structure: The OVC members (Cu2Ga4Te7, CuGa3Te5) are ordered defect chalcopyrites with cation vacancies; same family, different superstructure.

dopant_roles.basis: Cu vacancies are the intrinsic acceptor in the OVC members.

basis: Ba8Cu4.8Si41.2 (13) type-I clathrate. The SiC additions are composite second phases, not framework substitution.

dopant_roles.basis: SiC is added as a composite inclusion for phonon scattering.

basis: TAGS: (GeTe)85(AgSbTe2)15 (17) and neighbours. Rhombohedral R3m at room temperature, converting to cubic rocksalt near 520 K -- lower than pure GeTe because the AgSbTe2 content suppresses the distortion.

dopant_roles.basis: AgSbTe2 is an alloying end member, not a dilute dopant; Ag and Sb enter the cation site together.
Ge vacancies set the hole concentration and shift the transition temperature.

basis: (Ti,Zr)NiSn half-Heusler alloys with Sb donors; Ti/Zr mixing is isoelectronic mass-contrast phonon engineering.

solid_solution_axis.note: Ti/Zr alloying for mass-fluctuation scattering; isoelectronic throughout.

dopant_roles.basis: Excess Ni fills the structural vacancy.

basis: NbCoSn (14) half-Heusler; Sb on the Sn site is the n-type donor.
Sn1-xMnxTe (x up to ~0.15) rocksalt solid solution; Mn substitutes Sn and raises the valence-band convergence. MnTe beyond the solubility limit precipitates as a NiAs-type second phase.

dopant_roles.basis: Band-convergence agent; beyond ~15% it exceeds solubility and forms MnTe second phase.
Cu2Te additions act as a separate phase and as interstitial Cu.
Sn vacancies give SnTe its very high intrinsic hole concentration.

basis: Al62Cu25.5Fe12.5 (14) icosahedral quasicrystal, the classic i-AlCuFe system. No periodic structure.

dopant_roles.basis: Composition within the icosahedral phase field; the i-phase window is narrow.

basis: Cu2ZnSnSe4 (20) quaternary diamond-like. Stannite and kesterite differ only in cation ordering.

dopant_roles.basis: Cu/Zn off-stoichiometry is the standard carrier control in CZTSe.

basis: Four distinct families: Mo4O11 (19) and Mo8O23 (9) are Magneli-type shear phases, MoO2 (4) is rutile, Li0.9Mo6O17 is the purple bronze and Rb/K MoO3 the blue bronze. Not one prototype.
taxonomy_feedback: The WO3 distortion_series was firing on this host because it shares the reo3_wo3 prototype. Molybdenum oxides do not follow that sequence; the series is now scoped with applies_to_hosts.

dopant_roles.basis: The Mo-O system is a homologous series in oxygen content; this is the structural variable.
Tunnel/gallery cation in the purple bronze.
Tunnel cation in the blue bronze.

basis: CeFe4Sb12 (25) and Co-substituted members -- all filled p-type skutterudites, none unfilled.

dopant_roles.basis: Filling fraction sets the carrier count; not a substitutional dopant.

basis: Bi2Ba2Co2O8 (13) -- the [Bi2Ba2O4][CoO2]x misfit layered cobaltite, the Ba analogue of the Sr and Ca phases.

other_polymorphs.note: Incommensurate; rocksalt and CoO2 subsystems map separately.

basis: Mg2Si1-xGex antifluorite solid solution; Ge and Si mix freely on the anion site.

solid_solution_axis.note: Complete Mg2Si-Mg2Ge solid solution, unlike Mg2Si-Mg2Sn which has a miscibility gap.

basis: BaTiO3 (6) and substituted titanates, mp-2998 with 94 ICSD references. BaTiO3 is tetragonal below ~393 K and cubic above, so the measured window crosses that ferroelectric transition.

dopant_roles.basis: SrRuO3 layers in the superlattice compositions are a separate phase.
Oxygen vacancies are the intrinsic donor in reduced titanates.

basis: ZrCoSb (19) half-Heusler; Sn on the Sb site is the p-type acceptor.

dopant_roles.basis: Acceptor, the standard p-type route for ZrCoSb.

basis: CuFeO2 (12) delafossite; CuFe2O4 (3) is the spinel ferrite, a different compound in the same host.

dopant_roles.basis: Excess oxygen generates p-type carriers in delafossites.

basis: Ba0.5Sr0.5FeO3-delta (9) cubic perovskite with large oxygen deficiency; the Co-substituted members are BSCF.

dopant_roles.basis: Heavily oxygen-deficient; delta dominates the transport.
B-site alloying at x=0.2, not dilute doping.

basis: CeCu6 (32) orthorhombic heavy-fermion compound; CeCu2 (7) is the KHg2-type phase, a different compound in the same host.

dopant_roles.basis: Au substitution drives CeCu6 to a quantum critical point; an alloying variable rather than dilute doping.

basis: Fe2TiSn (17) L21 full Heusler, a pseudogap thermoelectric of the Fe2VAl family.

dopant_roles.basis: Fe/Ti off-stoichiometry and antisite disorder tune the pseudogap filling.

basis: Ag2Te (25) hessite, monoclinic below ~418 K and converting to the fcc superionic phase above it -- inside the measured window.
note_structure: Ag2Te is monoclinic P2_1/c at ambient rather than the orthorhombic P212121 of Ag2Se; the prototype entry covers both with a note.

dopant_roles.basis: Ag excess/deficiency sets the carrier count.

basis: NdNiO3 (37) orthorhombic nickelate perovskite; Nd2NiO4 members are Ruddlesden-Popper.

dopant_roles.basis: Nickelates reduce readily; oxygen content drives the metal-insulator transition.

basis: CePd3 (13) AuCu3-type intermediate-valence compound.

dopant_roles.basis: Light interstitials in CePd3 occupy the octahedral void and tune the valence.

basis: CoSi (32) B20 chiral cubic, a topological semimetal thermoelectric.
BiFeO3 (11) rhombohedral R3c multiferroic perovskite; La substitutes on the Bi site.

dopant_roles.basis: Oxygen vacancies from Bi volatility are endemic in BiFeO3.

basis: SnBi2Te4 (5), SnBi4Te7 (4) and (Bi2Te3)(SnTe) mixtures -- natural superlattices of rocksalt SnTe slabs and Bi2Te3 quintuple layers.

dopant_roles.basis: The SnTe:Bi2Te3 ratio selects the homologue (n,m), not a doping level.

basis: La1-xSrxFeO3 (10) orthorhombic ferrite perovskite with Co and Ni B-site substitution.

dopant_roles.basis: Oxygen vacancies compensate the A-site acceptor doping.

basis: Elemental Cu (16) and dilute alloys, fcc. Reference metal rather than a thermoelectric.

dopant_roles.basis: Cu-Ni is a complete solid solution.

basis: Nb1-xTixFeSb (10+) half-Heusler; Ti on the Nb site is the p-type acceptor and at x=0.2 is alloying-level.

solid_solution_axis.note: Ti-for-Nb is aliovalent (acceptor) as well as mass-contrasting, so this axis is doping and alloying at once.

dopant_roles.basis: Acceptor; the main p-type route for NbFeSb, used at alloying levels.
Fe excess (Fe1.05) fills the structural vacancy.

basis: Mg2Ge1-xSnx antifluorite solid solution with Li and Sb dopants.
SrSi2 (15) chiral cubic P4332 narrow-gap semiconductor. Assigned from knowledge: the reference offers only Sr2Si and Sr5Si3, neither of which is the 1:2 compound these papers measure.
reference_failure: Neither TEDesignLab nor the MP fallback returned an SrSi2 entry; the ref line lists Sr2Si (Pnma) and Sr5Si3 (I4/mcm), different compounds in the same host.

basis: Ba8Cu4.5Si6Ge35.5 (17) type-I clathrate with a mixed Si/Ge framework.

solid_solution_axis.note: Si/Ge mixing within the cage framework, on top of Cu substitution.

basis: GeBi2Te4 (19) and GeBi4Te7 -- rocksalt GeTe slabs interleaved with Bi2Te3 quintuple layers.

dopant_roles.basis: The GeTe:Bi2Te3 ratio selects the homologue, not a doping level.

basis: LixCoO2 (5+) O3-type layered rocksalt derivative. Li content sets the Co3+/Co4+ ratio and is the compositional variable, not doping.

dopant_roles.basis: Li0.6-1.0CoO2: the lithium content IS the carrier-concentration variable.

basis: Pr1-xSrxFeO3 (6) perovskite ferrites across the full substitution range.

dopant_roles.basis: A-site hole doping at alloying levels (x up to 0.6).

basis: FeSe (47) -- the tetragonal PbO-type '11' superconductor, which is what these papers synthesise. The reference primary is the hexagonal NiAs-type phase (36 ICSD refs): thermodynamically stable in the Fe-Se system but not the phase measured here.

other_polymorphs.note: Hexagonal NiAs-type FeSe, 36 ICSD references at hull 0.195. A real and common phase in this system, but the tetragonal beta-FeSe is the superconducting one these papers target.

reference_failure: ICSD-weighted ranking returns the hexagonal NiAs-type phase; the tetragonal P4/nmm FeSe the papers measure is absent from the ref line. A case where the reference describes the chemistry correctly but not the sample.

dopant_roles.basis: Fe0.89Se: iron deficiency is intrinsic and controls whether the tetragonal phase superconducts.

basis: Pr1-xCaxMnO3 (5+) manganite perovskite across the charge-ordered composition range.

dopant_roles.basis: A-site hole doping at alloying levels; x=0.375-0.5 is the charge-ordered regime.

basis: SnS (13) orthorhombic Pnma, mp-2231 hull 0 with 19 ICSD references, converting to Cmcm near 880 K. SnS2 (4) is a 1T dichalcogenide, a different compound.

dopant_roles.basis: Acceptor, the standard p-type dopant for SnS.
Sn vacancies give the intrinsic hole concentration.

basis: Cd3As2 (49) -- the Dirac semimetal, an ordered-vacancy antifluorite superstructure. Assigned from knowledge: the reference returns CdAs2 and CdAs, neither of which is the 3:2 compound.
reference_failure: Reference primary is CdAs2 (I4_122); Cd3As2 itself is absent from the ref line for this host.

dopant_roles.basis: Cd vacancy ordering defines the superstructure and the carrier count.

basis: CsBi4Te6 (11) -- anionic Bi4Te6 slabs with Bi-Bi bonds separated by Cs; a low-temperature thermoelectric.

dopant_roles.basis: SbI3 additions dope via both Sb and I.

basis: InSb (22) zincblende III-V. The MnSb and NiSb additions are second-phase composites, not substitution.

dopant_roles.basis: MnSb forms a separate ferromagnetic phase in these composites.

basis: YbZn2Sb2 (17) CaAl2Si2-type 1-2-2 Zintl; Yb9Zn4.2Sb9 (3) is the 9-4-9 phase, a different polyanion in the same host.

dopant_roles.basis: Carrier tuning on the tetrahedral site.
Yb vacancies set the hole count in the 1-2-2 Zintls.

basis: Al74.6Mn17.4Si8 is the Al-Mn-Si icosahedral phase and its alpha-AlMnSi approximant -- the original Shechtman system. The seed hypothesis of a chimney-ladder silicide is wrong: these are Al-rich quasicrystalline alloys, not MnSi1.75.

dopant_roles.basis: Si stabilises the icosahedral phase; part of the phase field, not doping.

basis: FeVSb (7) half-Heusler; Ti and Hf on the V site are the carrier-tuning substitutions.
YbAl3 (33) AuCu3-type intermediate-valence compound with a large low-temperature thermopower.

dopant_roles.basis: Light interstitials occupy the octahedral void.

basis: EuBa2Cu3O6+delta (14) -- the Eu member of the RBa2Cu3O7 123 family. Oxygen content is the doping variable.

dopant_roles.basis: The 6+delta oxygen content IS the doping variable in the 123 cuprates.
